summary.value_proposition: Provide a complete CRUD (ABM) interface for payments in the Swing Event Manager, allowing administrators to record, view, modify, and delete payments, associated with existing event reservations.
summary.narrowest_wedge: Implementing CRUD for payments using the existing Reserva listing and DB model.
summary.key_risk: SQL exceptions or input type mismatch crashes when updating/inserting payments without proper field validation or database sync.
